start.if: flag('signal_decoded') and near('lin', 9) and not flag('artifact_resolved')

variants.text: The lines on the spire are moving. No - they are holding still, and it is you that is being read.
Close up, the surface is not stone. It gives slightly under the eye, like deep water. The scored lines pulse, slow as breathing.

touch.speaker: narrator
text: For one heartbeat there is a sound behind your teeth, patient and very large, like a question being asked in a language made of waiting.
Then it is only a pillar in the dark again, and your hand is shaking.

study.speaker: narrator
study.text: The marks are not writing. They are a carrier wave drawn in three dimensions - the same figure Lin has pinned over her bench, here cut a metre high. Whoever made this did not leave a message. They left a receiver.

with_lin.speaker: narrator
with_lin.text: Lin is standing with her palm a centimetre from the surface, not quite touching. She has clearly been waiting for you.
